summary: The discussion explores adding metadata or Thrift fields to Parquet to encode min/max length constraints for vector types 1.19.0 The discussion proposes a new Parquet logical type called WIRE that stores serialized wire-format messages as raw bytes while enabling selective columnar shredding of frequently queried fields. The results highlight that gains shrink when measured against highly optimized existing code and that adopting a new layout adds complexity to writers. The discussion centers on creating a higher‑level document that compares several numeric encodings—DELTA_BINARY_PACKED, PFOR, FastLanes, and potential optimizations—across speed, storage efficiency, and development effort. Antoine apologizes for earlier harsh remarks and emphasizes the importance of evaluating maintenance effort to move ideas into production.
